details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K5, and K6 are fully represented with supporting sentences covering all core material meanings. K4 is PARTIALLY_PRESENT because while the candidate mentions vehicle finance and consumer finance segments and highlights growth in specific markets (Romania, Uganda, Albania), it does not explicitly state the exact portfolio split percentages (67% vehicle finance, 33% consumer finance) or name all brands (Kredo, Tigo) as required by the core criterion. K7 is MISSING as there is no mention of post-reporting period events (March 2025 bond tap or North Macedonia tax refund). The overall coverage is strong with only a minor omission in K4, justifying a score of 4 (Yes).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction. Key performance metrics (profit, revenue, loan portfolio) show consistent growth trends. Strategic initiatives (IPO, market expansion, sustainability efforts) are clearly linked to financial outcomes. The summary maintains clear organizational flow from financial highlights to strategic achievements to future outlook. No material repetitions or logical gaps are present. While segment revenue figures don't sum to total revenue (EUR 95.5m + EUR 73.1m + EUR 48.0m = EUR 216.6m), the candidate does not claim these are exhaustive additive components of the total, so this is not considered a coherence error under the specified guidelines.
